title: My Daughter-In-Law Forged A Dissolution, Sold My Lab, Left Me $4,400. So I Voided The Sale
description: I poured my $133,000 nursing pension into a dental-appliance lab with my daughter-in-law and notarized a 50/50 partnership. She forged a dissolution, sold the lab and patient mold archive for $710,000, and left me a $4,400 check. Then I found the original agreement inside a plaster denture mold and voided the sale. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #DentalLab
thumb_text: SHE SOLD MY $710K LAB LEFT ME $4,400
pinned_comment: If your daughter-in-law forged a dissolution to sell your $133,000 dental lab for $710,000 and left you a $4,400 check, would you have voided the sale like I did, or taken the money and walked away? Tell me your story in the comments.
